decisions.reason: The firm has invested in and publicly committed to this navigation/observation camera with a dedicated product page, and it is close to its established offer, so escalation of commitment implies persistence.
The modular camera line involves several models and a dedicated page, signaling high sunk costs and visible commitment, making dropping unlikely under escalation of commitment.
This sensor suite builds on the firm's established offer and has been visibly presented, so the firm will justify its earlier commitment and keep it.
Although only mentioned on the website, the miniaturized LiDAR aligns with the firm's announced direction toward compact sensors, and sunk investments still favor persistence.
